title: Evaluating the Components, Nutrients, and Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Properties of Centranthera grandiflora Benth Extracts.
authors: Yuan, Wenjuan; Liu, Xinlan; Wang, Xinting; Nian, Zejin; Wu, Xiaoyun; Zi, Chengting; Xu, Sha; Shen, Xiaojing; Wang, Xuanjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物的营养成分与抗氧化抗炎活性，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Centranthera grandiflora Benth is commonly utilized in China to take advantage of its purported health benefits. METHODS: Here, the chemical composition, nutritional value, and bioactivity of C. grandiflora Benth extract (CGE) are characterized, and the mechanisms through which it functions were explored. RESULTS: CGE was found to exhibit a favorable nutritional and biosafety profile, especially due to its high amino acid and mineral contents. A UPLC-ESI-Q-TOF/MS approach identified 20 compounds. Through network pharmacology analyses, the antioxidant activity of CGE was found to be mediated through the PI3K/Akt pathway, with molecular docking results providing support for mussaenoside and azafrin as important bioactive compounds. At the cellular level, antioxidant activity of key protective antioxidants including GSH-Px and SOD while suppressing ROS accumulation, levels of damage-related factors (MDA, NO, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6), and iNOS and COX-2 in RAW264.7 cells treated with LPS. These findings offer potential evidence for using CGE to lower oxidative stress and inflammation. Further analyses demonstrated the ability of CGE to promote Nrf2 and HO-1 upregulation, whereas Keap1 levels were suppressed, as were PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB proteins. In light of these results, CGE appears to be able to act via simultaneously enhancing Nrf2/HO-1 activity and reducing that of PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB. CONCLUSIONS: CGE, as a rich source of iridoid glycosides and other nutrients, may thus be a valuable dietary supplement for use in food applications.
abstract_zh: 背景：大花胡麻草（Centranthera grandiflora Benth）在中国常被用于利用其宣称的健康益处。方法：本研究对C. grandiflora Benth提取物（CGE）的化学成分、营养价值及生物活性进行了表征，并探讨了其作用机制。结果：CGE表现出良好的营养和生物安全性特征，尤其因其高氨基酸和矿物质含量。采用UPLC-ESI-Q-TOF/MS方法鉴定出20种化合物。通过网络药理学分析，发现CGE的抗氧化活性通过PI3K/Akt通路介导，分子对接结果支持桃叶珊瑚苷（mussaenoside）和玄参苷（azafrin）作为重要生物活性化合物。在细胞水平上，CGE在LPS处理的RAW264.7细胞中增强了关键保护性抗氧化剂（如GSH-Px和SOD）的活性，同时抑制了ROS积累、损伤相关因子（MDA、NO、TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6）的水平以及iNOS和COX-2的表达。这些发现为使用CGE降低氧化应激和炎症提供了潜在证据。进一步分析表明，CGE能够促进Nrf2和HO-1的上调，而Keap1水平被抑制，PI3K/Akt/NF-κB蛋白同样受到抑制。鉴于这些结果，CGE似乎能够通过同时增强Nrf2/HO-1活性和降低PI3K/Akt/NF-κB活性来发挥作用。结论：CGE作为环烯醚萜苷和其他营养素的丰富来源，因此可能作为食品应用中有价值的膳食补充剂。
